summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) of the cipher-box project, which involves deploying Grafana alert rules and tuning client timeout/retry constants.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 plans were discovered to be missing initially, then found to already exist in the correct repo. Execution was launched with 2 agents running in parallel for Wave 1 (plans 26-01 and 26-02), but the transcript ends before completion is confirmed.

repo: Phase 26 has 2 plans in a single wave: 26-01 (Grafana alert rules as JSON with provisioning script) and 26-02 (client timeout/retry tuning across SDK pinning providers)
GSD tools can run against the wrong working directory, causing false 'no plans found' errors — the tools need to be invoked from the correct repo root
Phase 26 had research and context already committed before planning was run, but the phase directory appeared empty to the initial GSD init call due to directory mismatch

code.finding: Contains 2 PLAN.md files, RESEARCH.md, CONTEXT.md, and VALIDATION.md — all committed before execute-phase was run
Updated at phase start via `gsd-tools state begin-phase` to reflect active phase 26

workflow: The GSD execute-phase workflow requires plans to exist before it can run — if none are found, it redirects to /gsd:plan-phase
When /gsd:plan-phase finds existing plans, it skips planning and goes straight to offering execute-phase
The GSD init command can silently target the wrong working directory, causing phantom 'no plans' errors that resolve when invoked from the correct directory
Wave 1 parallel agent spawning is the final logged action — outcome depends on subagent completion not shown in transcript

friction: Initial execute-phase run failed with 'no plans found' because GSD tools ran against the wrong directory (not the `cipher-box-ci-debug` repo where plans exist)
Required a second invocation of both plan-phase and execute-phase after diagnosing the directory mismatch
plan-phase init reported missing context/research despite those files being committed — same root cause as the directory mismatch
open_items: Wave 1 agent execution (26-01 and 26-02) was still in progress when the transcript ends — outcome unknown
Post-wave verification, STATE.md/ROADMAP.md updates, regression gate, and phase completion steps are all pending
